snippet.title: Pale Incense | Official Game Introduction
snippet.description:
Enter the dark and atmospheric world of Pale Incense, a first-person gothic action-simulation game where every day and every night brings a different challenge.

By day, run your perfume shop, create unique fragrances and serve your customers. By night, embrace your vampire nature, hunt through the streets of a dangerous gothic city, gather the resources you need, and stay one step ahead of those hunting you.

Play as Edmund, a vampire perfumer struggling to save his dying wife, Johanna, after a failed transformation leaves her gravely ill. Balance your life as a shopkeeper and a vampire while uncovering a story of love, immortality, guilt, and sacrifice.
